title: Guide local coding via the guided_coding Agentic Recipe
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `guided_coding` durable graph (controller `story`, store `memory`). He wants Cursor to answer only short engineering direction while a project-local MechaHarness process classifies oneshot vs todo list and does the token-heavy file edits under pre/item/post acceptance. Start yields `advice_requested` from soft point `external_guidance`; he answers `minimal` in a later call and the run completes. In a workspace-backed walk he has the agent write a small helper module, confirms the file on disk, and runs Python against it to check stdout. Git inspect and mocked pull-request handoffs are owned by `fangore_coding_git_inspect` and `fangore_coding_git_open_pr`. Complements `fangore_instruction_todo_plan`, `fangore_insp_graph_guidance_yield`, and `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`. He walks product steps (start, answer, workspace_read, run_python) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on each scenario.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` (`GuidedCodingTemplate`) tiles `instruction_todo_plan` and `audited_infer_accept` under `plan_tile` / `audit_tile` with soft point `external_guidance` (`kind=guidance`). MCP `MECHA_MCP_HOST=project_coding` binds `ProjectCodingConfig` (workspace coding tools + `GeneratorLocalWork` / `ProjectCodingLocalWork` burst after guidance, including `request_guidance` restart for plan refinement). Injectable `CodingGit` (default `LocalProcessCodingGit`; story/CI often `RecordingPullRequestCodingGit`) backs optional git/PR tools — see `fangore_coding_git_inspect` / `fangore_coding_git_open_pr`. Story hosts bind `environment.local_work: project_coding` with a temp workspace and optional `coding_write` stub. `ProjectCodingLocalWork` records `written_files` / `workspace_root` on the completed yield. Product verbs `workspace_read` and `run_python` put file text and stdout/stderr/exit_code into the step observation bag. `DurableGraphGenerator._advance` invokes the injectable local-work hook when the guidance queue is empty.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenarios `session.yaml` (NoOp guidance smoke) and `helper_run_python.yaml` (project_coding workspace write + workspace_read + run_python expects). Both scenarios pin generator counters (`guidance_yields` / `resumes` / `local_steps`) and `tapped_event_types` / `event_types` so unexpected durable or coding-graph executions fail hard. Unit tests `tests/test_project_coding.py` (including git tool confinement / unsafe-ref rejection), `tests/test_guided_coding_recipe.py`, and `tests/test_cli_workspace_verbs.py` cover tools confinement, plan/audit tile topology, offline local-work file write, and workspace verbs.
